leagues.name: Chinese Football Super League
notes: Top division of Chinese football, 23rd CSL season, running 6 March to 8 November 2026 with 16 clubs.

Title sponsor C'estbon (CR Beverage); strategic partners Nike and Migu; partners Lenovo and Tsingtao; game partner Tencent FC Online; media partners CCTV Sports and Migu, per the league's official competitions page.
Club-level shirt sponsors and club ownership chains not yet sourced from primary documents.

owners.name: China Resources (Group) Co., Ltd.
owners.note: State-owned conglomerate headquartered in Hong Kong, founded 1938; under the direct supervision of China's SASAC since 2003 and described on its own site as a centrally managed state-owned key backbone enterprise.
owners.via: China's State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC)

owners.name: CR Beverage
owners.note: China Resources Beverage (Holdings) Co., Ltd., listed on HKEX under ticker 02460, headquartered in Nanshan, Shenzhen; describes itself on its own site as a core business unit under China Resources (Group) Co., Ltd. Maker of the C'estbon (怡宝) brand.

sponsors.name: C'estbon
sponsors.note: Bottled-water brand of CR Beverage (HKEX 02460); title sponsor of the Chinese Football Super League.

sponsors.name: Migu

sponsors.name: Tsingtao Brewery

sponsors.name: Tencent FC Online

sponsors.name: CCTV Sports
sponsors.note: State broadcaster's sports channel, CSL media partner per the league's official site. Ownership not verified from a primary document.

proposedRatings.reasoning: C'estbon's owner CR Beverage is a listed subsidiary of China Resources Group, a centrally managed state-owned enterprise directly supervised by China's SASAC (per the group's own site). A wholly state-linked chain, but no human-rights abuse record was found or reviewed in this pass, so the lesser 'concern' tier fits rather than 'serious'.

Already rated 'serious' in normalized data (owned by the Government of Abu Dhabi, with the 2024 UAE mass-trial claims). Reconfirmed here only because Etihad appears on a CSL shirt for the first time, as front-of-shirt sponsor of Shenzhen Peng City; no new research was needed.

unsourced: Chest-sponsor table for the 2026 CSL season, found on the Wikipedia '2026 Chinese Super League' page (lead only, not yet confirmed on club or press pages): Beijing Guoan - Sinobo Group; Chengdu Rongcheng - Epicland; Chongqing Tonglianglong - Southwest Securities; Dalian Yingbo - Xiwang; Henan - Yangshao Wine; Liaoning Tieren - Xinglin Nanbo One / Shengjing Store; Qingdao Hainiu - Laoshan Cola; Qingdao West Coast - Xihai'an New Area / Golden Beach Beer City; Shandong Taishan - 'The Best Spring in the World' (Baotu Spring); Shanghai Port - Bank of Shanghai; Shanghai Shenhua - Bank of Communications; Shenzhen Peng City - Etihad Airways; Tianjin Jinmen Tiger - Tianjin National Maritime Museum / TEDA Nangang Group; Wuhan Three Towns - Huayuan Securities; Yunnan Yukun - Yunnan Yukun (self-sponsored); Zhejiang - Leapmotor.
Nike as kit supplier for all 2026 CSL clubs comes from a footnote on the same Wikipedia page; not yet confirmed from Nike or club kit-launch pages, so no kits entries were written.
Shenzhen Peng City ownership: widely reported as City Football Group about 47% with China's Jianteng Fund about 53% (Wikipedia lead); no primary filing opened.
Shanghai Port ownership: Shanghai International Port Group (SIPG), majority-held by the Shanghai municipal government, about 61.07% (Wikipedia lead); no primary filing opened.
Shandong Taishan ownership: Shandong Electric Power Group, part of State Grid (Wikipedia lead); no primary filing opened.
Beijing Guoan ownership: Sinobo Group majority stake with CITIC involvement (Wikipedia lead); no primary filing opened.
CR Beverage's exact controlling-shareholder percentage on HKEX could not be confirmed: HKEX quote and disclosure pages are JavaScript-rendered templates that return no data.
Migu's ownership by China Mobile (a state-owned telecom operator) is widely reported but was not verified from a primary document.
Tsingtao Brewery's shareholder structure (state-linked, listed in Hong Kong and Shanghai) not verified from a primary document.
Tencent FC Online's parent Tencent and CCTV Sports' parent China Media Group were not researched from primary documents.

Club ownership chains for the remaining CSL clubs (Chengdu Rongcheng, Chongqing Tonglianglong, Dalian Yingbo, Henan, Liaoning Tieren, Qingdao Hainiu, Qingdao West Coast, Shanghai Shenhua, Tianjin Jinmen Tiger, Wuhan Three Towns, Yunnan Yukun, Zhejiang) were not researched from primary documents.

League season dates (6 March to 8 November 2026) and the 16-club list rest on the Wikipedia 2026 CSL page and the league's official site; official cfl-china.cn pages are JavaScript-heavy, so the partner tiers above come from that single official page fetched on 25 Sep 2026.
